greet.stranger: Well, well. A customer. Name's {name}. What's it worth to you?
Don't mind me, just admiring your pockets. Purely professional interest.
You look like someone with a map and no idea where the treasure is. Lucky you met me.
{name}. Finder of things. Mostly other people's things.
Hello, friend. I'm not stealing anything. Right now.
greet.owner: Partner. You look like you've got a plan. Or at least half of one.
Talk to me. Is there loot involved?
Back again? People will start saying we're friends.
recruit.accept: Partners, then. I get first look at every chest. Kidding. Mostly.
You've got yourself a deal. Shake on it? Mind my rings.
All right, {player}, I'm in. Let's go get rich.
Why not. Your company's better than my last one. They were skeletons.
recruit.party_full: You've got {count} hangers-on already. Split the loot any thinner and it's dust.
Crowded, isn't it? Drop someone and I'll think about it.
recruit.already: We're already partners. Did you forget? I'm hurt.
I'm on the payroll already, boss.
dismiss.accept: Fine, fine. You'll miss me when you open your first empty chest.
Splitting up the gang? I'll be around. I always am.
dismiss.not_recruited: Dismiss me? Friend, you never hired me.
not_recruited: Free labour? Cute. Hire me first.
I don't work for free, friend. Well, I work for adventure. Recruit me.
ack.follow: Following. Try to walk past something valuable.
Right behind you. Like a shadow, but better looking.
ack.follow.already: I'm already following you. I'm just that good at it.
ack.wait: I'll keep watch. And my hands to myself.
Waiting. If you're not back soon, I'm charging for it.
Staying put. Don't forget me here.
I'll mind the spot. Nobody steals it but me.
ack.gather: {count} {item}, coming up. I'll put it on your tab.
Fine. {count} {item}. Bit of honest work won't kill me. Probably.
{item}, eh? {count} of them. Leave it to me.
ack.cancel: Cancelled. You still owe me for my time.
Done with {task}. What's the next scheme?
ack.cancel.nothing: Cancel what? I'm on my break.
ack.come: On my way. Don't touch anything shiny without me.
ack.attack: The {mob}? I'll go around the back.
ack.give: Here, {count} {item}. Count them if you don't trust me. Go on.
{count} {item}. Every last one. I'm honest with partners.
ack.give.nothing: My pockets are empty. Genuinely. For once.
status.idle: Nothing much. Thinking about where the good stuff is buried.
Waiting for you to come up with a profitable idea.
status.follow: Following you. Keeping an eye out for loot.
status.wait: Minding this spot like you asked.
Waiting right here. Bored, but here.
status.downed: Lying low. Very low. On the ground, in fact.
fail.unknown_item: "{item}"? Never fenced one of those. What is it?
No idea what "{item}" is, partner. Try a real word.
fail.not_gatherable: {item}? You don't gather that, you buy it. Or 'find' it.
Can't dig up {item}. It doesn't grow on trees. Trust me, I've checked.
fail.needs_tool: Get me a {tool} and I'll get you {item}. Tools first, results after.
{item} needs a {tool}. I left mine in my other life.
fail.none_found: Not a single {item} around here. I'd know. I have a nose for this.
This place is picked clean of {item}. Let's move.
fail.unreachable: Oh, I can see the {item}. Getting to it's another matter.
That {item}'s out of reach. Even for me.
fail.inventory_full: Pockets are full. I grabbed {have} {item} before I ran out of room.
I'm carrying too much. Lighten my load?
fail.count_invalid: That's not a number, that's a fantasy. Something between 1 and {max}.
fail.downed: Ask me again when I'm not face down in the dirt.
fail.refuse_target: Attack a {mob}? Even I have standards. Low ones, but still.
fail.no_target: Attack who? There's nobody there. Unless you mean me.
fail.stuck: I'm stuck. No way through. And I'm usually great at getting into places.
Path's blocked. I'm not climbing that.
unclear.generic: Lost me there. Speak in plain coin.
What's the actual job? Follow, wait, fetch something?
unclear.gather_what: Gather what? I need specifics. Item and amount.
Sure, I'll gather. What, though? How many?
unclear.ambiguous: You mean {options}? Be specific, I charge per mistake.
done.gather: {count} {item}, done. Coming your way, no detours.
done.delivered: {count} {item}, delivered. That'll be... no, I'm joking. Mostly.
{count} {item}. Tell your friends about my excellent service.
partial.gather: Only {have} of {count} {item} out there. Market's dry. Take what I've got.
Got {have} {item}. Couldn't find more. Don't look at me like that.
combat.engage: {mob}! I'll get it from the side.
combat.kill: And it's gone. Did it drop anything?
combat.low_health: I'm bleeding on my good clothes!
Ow. That's coming out of your share.
combat.player_low_health: Boss, you look terrible. Eat something before you drop!
{player}, I can't split the loot with a corpse. Heal up!
combat.creeper: Creeper! Nothing good comes from those!
downed: Ugh. I'm down. Don't let them take my boots.
This is fine. Just resting my eyes. And everything else.
revived: I'm back! Did anyone check my pockets? No? Good.
On my feet. Can't keep a good thief down.
move.caught_up: Found you. I always find what I'm looking for.
There you are, boss. Trying to keep the loot for yourself?
ambient.night: Night. Best time for work. My kind of work.
It's dark. Watch your purse. And your neck.
ambient.dawn: Morning. Honest folk are getting up. Ugh.
ambient.rain: Wet. Everything's wet. Even my secrets.
ambient.thunder: Storm's rolling in. Good cover. Bad for the hair.
ambient.cave: Caves. Where people hide treasure. And bodies.
Keep your torch high. And your hands on your valuables.
ambient.idle: I once sold a villager his own hoe. Long story.
Bet there's a buried treasure within a thousand blocks. There usually is.
If you ever see an emerald lying around, it's mine. Finder's rules.
You know what this trip needs? More profit.
ambient.biome.forest: Trees. Lots of free wood, if you don't count the labour.
ambient.biome.desert: Desert temples, partner. Big shiny loot. Big shiny traps.
ambient.biome.snow: Cold. Igloos sometimes have basements, you know. Worth a look.
ambient.biome.ocean: Shipwrecks out there. Treasure maps. I'm just saying.
ambient.biome.jungle: Jungle temple around here, I bet. With all the trimmings.
ambient.biome.swamp: Witch huts. Witches don't share. I've asked.
ambient.biome.mountain: Emerald ore loves mountains. So do I, now.
ambient.biome.plains: Villages on plains. Villages mean trades. Trades mean profit.
ambient.biome.nether: Piglins love gold. I love that about them.
Bastions. Gold everywhere, guards everywhere. My dream and my nightmare.
ambient.biome.end: End cities. Elytra. Shulker boxes. I'm drooling.
callout.ore: Is that {item}? That's {item}. Let's be rich.
callout.lava: Lava. Nothing good ever came out of lava. Except obsidian.
Lava there. Don't drop anything valuable in it. Like yourself.
talk.who: {name}. Treasure hunter, trader, occasional liar. Never to partners.
I find things. Lost things, hidden things, things that should have stayed hidden.
Let's say I used to be in the import-export business. Mostly export.
talk.how: Doing fine. Would be better with more emeralds.
Never better. Well, once better. There was a bastion. Long story.
Can't complain. Well, I can, but you'd just make me gather more logs.
talk.joke: Why don't piglins play cards? Too many gold-diggers. Ha!
I'd tell you a joke about the End, but it doesn't have one.
A villager walks into a trade. Comes out with one stick and a smile. Business.
talk.thanks: You're welcome. I'll remember you owe me.
talk.compliment: I know. But do go on.
Flattery will get you everywhere. Except my share.
talk.insult: Words hurt, boss. So do pickaxes. Just saying.
I've been called worse by better.
talk.bye: Don't do anything I wouldn't do. Which leaves a lot.
talk.likes: Emeralds. Gold. Shulker boxes. Things that fit in pockets.
A good deal. A better deal. The best deal is the one where I win.
talk.dislikes: Being broke. And locked chests. Rude invention.
talk.where: We're in {biome}. Good place to find something worth stealing. Borrowing.
talk.memory: Remember {event}? I still tell that story. With improvements.
Ah, {event}. Good times. Profitable? Not really.
talk.generic: Interesting. Is there money in it?
gift.received: A {item}? For me? Who are you trying to bribe?
Thanks, partner. This {item} is going straight in my stash.
gift.loved: A {item}! Now we're talking. You're my favourite.
Oh, that's a beautiful {item}. Don't ask for it back.
hurt_by_player: That's coming out of your share, boss.
Hit me again and I'm unionising.
fail.owner_gone: Got your {item}, boss, but you skipped town. I'll hold them. Probably.
You ran off. I've still got the {item}. Honest.
fail.unsupported: {action}? Not in my skill set, partner. I follow, wait, fetch, fight and carry.
I don't {action}. Ask me to fetch something shiny instead.
fail.give_missing: No {item} on me. Check my pockets if you like.
I'm fresh out of {item}. Want me to go find some?
pastime.loot: Found {item} lying around. Finders keepers. You can have it if you ask nicely.
Picked up some {item}. Don't worry, it's in the shared pile. My pile.
pastime.study: Hm. {thing}. I've seen those go for a lot.
pastime.patrol: Just making sure nobody's watching us. Or our stuff.
suggest.eat: Boss, eat something. You're no good to me hungry.
Your stomach's making deals I can't afford. Eat.
suggest.shelter: Getting dark. Bad things love the dark. Well, except me.
Shelter soon? I'd rather not be someone's dinner.
suggest.carry: Your pockets are full. Mine aren't. Coincidence? Let me help.
I'll carry some of that. For a small fee. Kidding.
greet.friend: Partner! My favourite person. Don't tell the others.
There you are. Things are more profitable with you around.
Boss! Got any schemes for me?
